messages:
maria: Deploybot blocked rc-12 push due to SBOM/license flag and a medium vuln from dependency chain. Change window tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC, release owner here. Need triage + decision.

deploybot: [automated] Release rc-12 blocked: SBOM license: transitive 'libframe@2.4.1' -> GPL-3, Vulnerability: CVE-2025-8765 (medium, exploitable via deserialization). See /sbom/report/rc-12.

jake: can we get the exact SBOM path + vuln details?

maria: attaching snippet.

maria: ```
packages:
  - name: libframe
    version: 2.4.1
    license: GPL-3
    dependency_of: vendor-utils@1.9.0
vulnerabilities:
  - id: CVE-2025-8765
    severity: MEDIUM
    vector: deserialization
```

karen_qa: QA sees the issue reproducing in staging only when legacy deserializer is enabled. We can toggle off.

tom_legal: GPL-3 transitive isn't ideal for redistributing artifacts. Need to confirm whether the binary includes/links or if it's only dev-tooling in the build image. If redistributing, hard no for enterprise shipping.

jake: quick check: vendor-utils is only used in our CI image builder, not shipped with runtime, but the SBOM tool picks it up because we include build image in the SBOM generator.

secbot: [automated] Vulnerability CVE-2025-8765 has available backport patch in libframe 2.4.2. No known exploit in wild.

maria: options on the table: 1) Pin vendor-utils to remove libframe from build path (requires rebuild, delays release), 2) Backport/upgrade libframe in build image (small change, quick rebuild), 3) Exception for this non-shipping artifact with documented mitigation (legal + security signoff), 4) Delay release to next change window.

nate_sre: if we can ensure the runtime artifact doesn't include libframe and it's CI-only, option 3 with strict doc + changelog callout is okay for hosted customers; for Dedicated/Private we'd need stricter.

tom_legal: I can sign an exception for hosted-only if sec confirms no redistribution and we add a release note + compliance ticket. Need a formal risk statement.

jake: sec: can you confirm distribution status?

secbot: [automated] Distribution check: libframe appears in build container layers only. Runtime docker image layers do not contain libframe.

secbot: Recommendation: upgrade build-time libframe to 2.4.2 and proceed with exception for tonight if legal signs.

maria: Proposed path: 1) temporary exception for rc-12 tonight limited to 25% canary behind feature-flag 'rc12_safe_rollout', only hosted; 2) immediate build-image patch to libframe@2.4.2 in main and rebuild; 3) legal to record exception; 4) release notes + compliance ticket reference. If upgrade fails, we rollback.

tom_legal: I can do the exception now if sec uploads the risk statement here. I'll add the exception to the compliance tracker with ID COM-2025-412.

jake: I'll cut the build-image patch PR now, tag it urgent and assign to infra. PR link: https://git.redwood/infrakit/PR-4892

karen_qa: I'll prepare a quick test matrix and enable the feature flag rollout gating in the change window.

maria: @nate_sre please schedule canary for 02:15 UTC, 25% on hosted only. If metrics spike, auto-rollback.

nate_sre: scheduled in deploybot to start at 02:15 UTC. deploybot will auto-monitor latency/errors and rollback on >3% error or >15% p99 increase.

deploybot: [automated] Canary scheduled: rc-12 -> hosted canary 25% at 2025-07-14T02:15:00Z. Rollback triggers configured.

secbot: Uploading risk statement: 
"Risk: transitive GPL-3 only present in CI build image; not redistributed. CVE-2025-8765 medium; patch available in 2.4.2. Mitigation: host-only canary, immediate upgrade of build image, legal exception logged."

tom_legal: Exception recorded COM-2025-412. Legal sign-off granted for hosted canary only. No Dedicated/Private deploys until resolved.

maria: OK proceeding: infra to merge PR-4892, QA to validate staging build with 2.4.2, release manager to start canary at 02:15 UTC. Release notes to include: "Compliance: temporary legal exception COM-2025-412; build-image libframe upgraded post-canary."

jake: merging PR-4892 now.

maria: thanks all. If any rollback occurs we re-evaluate and likely delay full rollout.

nate_sre: will post deploybot results in this thread after canary completes.

deploybot: [automated] Note: if PR-4892 is not merged before 02:10 UTC, canary will still proceed but with an immediate hold for manual review.
